567:   sanitizeUrlComponent(
568:     component: string | undefined,
569:     index: number,
570:     total: number,
571:   ): string | null {
572:     if (typeof component !== 'string') {
573:       throw new TypeError(`Url must be a string. Received ${typeof component}`);
574:     }
575:     if (component === '') {
576:       if (index === total - 1 && this.urlPolicy.hasEndingSlash) {
577:         return '/';
578:       }
579:       return null;
580:     }
581:     if (component === '/') {
582:       this.urlPolicy.hasEndingSlash = true;
583:       return component;
584:     }
585:     let nextComponent = component;
586:     if (index > 0) {
587:       nextComponent = nextComponent.replace(
588:         /^\/+/,
589:         component.startsWith('/') && !this.urlPolicy.hasStartingSlash
590:           ? '/'
591:           : '',
592:       );
593:     }
594:     this.urlPolicy.hasEndingSlash = nextComponent.endsWith('/');
595:     nextComponent = nextComponent.replace(
596:       /\/+$/,
597:       index < total - 1 ? '' : '/',
598:     );

767:       }
768:       if (!fileLine.trim()) {
769:         continue;
770:       }
771:       if (this.isMarkdownImportLine(fileLine, inImport, inCode)) {
772:         inImport = true;
773:         continue;
774:       }
775:       if (fileLine.trim().startsWith(this.markdownPolicy.fenceOpener)) {
776:         const codeFence = fileLine.trim().match(/^`+/)![0]!;
777:         if (!inCode) {
778:           inCode = true;
779:           lastCodeFence = codeFence;
780:         } else if (codeFence.length >= lastCodeFence.length) {
781:           inCode = false;

## Summary

The bug: in `replaceMarkdownLinks` (packages/docusaurus-utils/src/markdownLinks.ts), a loose regex matched any text starting with `](...` whose substring ended in `.md`. So a relative image path like `./file.md__static_image_assets__/image.png` got its `./file.md` part wrongly rewritten to the doc's permalink `/docs/file`, turning the image link into an absolute path that then failed to resolve (falling back to `/static`).

The fix rewrites the link-detection logic to properly parse Markdown link syntax instead of pattern-guessing:
- `createLinkPattern()` (markdownLinks.ts:296) builds a precise regex for inline links (`[text](url "title")`, including `<>`-wrapped URLs, stray spaces, query/hash suffixes) and reference-style links (`[ref]: url`), with correct negative lookaheads for `http(s)://` and `@site/`.
- `replaceLineMarkdownLinks()` (markdownLinks.ts:314) uses capture indices to replace only the URL portion, and skips anything that doesn't genuinely end in `.md`/`.mdx` — so `./file.md_asset/1.png` and `./file.md__static_image_assets__/image.png` are left untouched for the mdx-loader's image/asset transforms to handle.

Verification:
- All 14 tests in `markdownLinks.test.ts` pass, including the two previously failing ones (`does not replace non-Markdown links`, `handles stray spaces`) with their existing snapshots.
- A scratch test reproducing the exact issue scenario passes (paths left unmodified, no broken links reported).
- No new failures across `docusaurus-utils`, `mdx-loader`, `content-blog`, and `content-docs` suites (14 failures there are identical to the baseline).
- `tsc` on the package is clean; eslint reports only pre-existing warnings.
